preconditions: Invoked from GameMainEntry (0x0045B200) as the per-frame main loop, so the game, session and conditional-pipeline subsystems it drives must already be initialized.
The restart gate (unk_7CE24D / byte_7CE254) and session manager (dword_7CD25C) must be readable on entry; the function reads them on every iteration.
postconditions: Returns 0 when the session state (dword_7CD25C) reads as 1 at the end of a body pass, or when the restart gate returned 4.
Returns 1 after any other non-5 restart-gate exit, having optionally written the debug log dword_8AD25C when the exit code is neither 4 nor 6 and StringSplitLoop accepts the message.
On entry the per-frame phase counter at *this offset 0x0 is set to 5 before the loop starts.
side_effects: Writes the loop phase counter: *this = 5 at offset 0x0.
Drives the conditional pipeline on dword_8AB6E4 (ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher, ConditionalStateUpdate, TwoPathDispatch) framed by ConditionalInit/ConditionalStateReset on unk_8AFE18.
Updates the session manager dword_7CD25C via sub_463CA0, SessionScoringUpdate and CollisionResponseStatus.
Resets the message buffer dword_7D2E50 and the vehicle iteration buffer dword_83EE60.

Runs the multi-phase simulation state machine on dword_5EA2C0, processes the module output list dword_8ACEE0, broadcasts collision updates through ppvOut, ticks the main game unk_5EC6D0 and iterates vehicles dword_83EE60.

On the byte_7CE254-set path updates weather particles dword_8ACEA0 only; otherwise additionally runs the camera director (dword_5EA510), render screen save (byte_8AB678) and short computation (dword_7CE048).
Advances the render tick byte_8AC494 and the conditional contexts unk_8AFEC0 and unk_7CE2A4 (sub_4FA7E0, sub_4FCEE0, sub_4A1830).
May write the debug log dword_8AD25C with the NextStateDWasN message on an unexpected restart-gate exit.
